target_audience: Brazilian women who value high-end imported cosmetics, perfumes, bodysplashes & skincare with a high-trust boutique aesthetic

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.15]

grid_modes.hero_tetris: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-center
grid_modes.editorial_manifesto: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 p-8 md:p-12
grid_modes.bento_products: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
grid_modes.dashboard_dense: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

spacing_and_layout.padding_philosophy: Use generous padding (py-20 to py-32 for sections) with strict internal card padding (p-6 to p-8) to avoid text collision.

motion_and_libraries.lenis_smooth_scroll: Wrap app with Lenis smooth momentum scrolling for effortless weighted movement.

framer_motion.line_by_line_reveal: Masked line reveal on Hero heading using initial opacity 0, y: 40, transition easeOut duration 0.8s staggered by line.
framer_motion.scroll_stagger: Viewport once: false, margin '-100px', opacity 0 to 1, y 30 to 0
framer_motion.hover_spotlight: Scale 1.03 with glow border highlight on product cards

motion_and_libraries.interactive_3d: Subtle interactive 3D/Canvas bottle float tilt effect with mouse light reflection

key_features_and_flows.hero_section: Kinetic Hero with line-by-line reveal, spotlight hero product framing, floating badges 'Original 100% Importado', quick CTA catalog jump
key_features_and_flows.manifesto_chapters: 3 Numbered Manifesto chapters (01. Curadoria Exclusiva, 02. Fixação & Autenticidade, 03. Experiência Boutique) with editorial typography and high-contrast lines
key_features_and_flows.editorial_marquee: Slow drifter marquee with low-contrast luxury text ('PERFUMES IMPORTADOS • BODY SPLASH • MAKEUP INTERNACIONAL • SKINCARE PREMIUM')
key_features_and_flows.product_catalog: Filter by category (Perfumes, Bodysplash, Maquiagem, Skincare), live search, variant selector, quick add to cart modal
key_features_and_flows.variant_selector_modal: Product detail modal supporting variants (e.g. Aroma 1 vs Aroma 2) updating price, photo, and stock live
key_features_and_flows.side_cart_drawer: Slide-over cart with subtotal, free shipping progress bar, and 1-click checkout options: Pix (InfinitePay - 5% OFF badge) & Cartão de Crédito (Mercado Pago até 12x)
key_features_and_flows.customer_account: Login / Registration modal & 'Meus Pedidos' order status tracking page
key_features_and_flows.admin_dashboard: Comprehensive Admin Panel to add/edit products with variants, financial parameters (markup, tax, shipping rates), payment credentials (Mercado Pago & InfinitePay keys), and sub-admins management

testing_attributes.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, cart triggers, and price displays MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='product-card-1', data-testid='variant-select-aroma-1', data-testid='checkout-pix-button', data-testid='admin-product-variant-add').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion micro-animations across all pages.
Build the Kinetic Hero with line-by-line masked text reveal & floating product spotlight.
Ensure all product cards include clipped frame styling, hover spotlight effects, and variant selection modals.
Integrate Mercado Pago (card) and InfinitePay (Pix) checkout options with dynamic discount calculation.
Implement full Admin Panel for managing products, variants, financial parameters, and credentials.
Apply Playfair Display for headings and Montserrat for body text. Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
